description: Department of Local Government - Uva Province - The meeting to elect a new Chairman to fill the Vacant Post of Chairman of the Mahiyangana P/S
reasoning: This gazette notice announces the convening of a meeting to elect a new Chairman for the Mahiyangana Pradeshiya Sabha, which falls under electoral processes for local government authorities. The content specifically references the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and its amendments, making it clearly about election-related administrative matters rather than government personnel changes or other specialized categories.
